Make an offering

Offer from what we have received.

Members of the parish may provide certain things used in the worship and life of the Church. Because some of them carry particular requirements, we want it to be easy to know what is needed, what kind to bring, when to bring it and whom to ask.

Those particulars are set by the parish, not by a website. Until Fr. John and Presbytera have confirmed them, every card below says so rather than guessing — a guess here would send somebody out to buy the wrong thing.
